segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Today's briefing, the briefing of the fiscal year 2027 proposed expenditure

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: program of the Office of the Vice President is now called to order. I would like to acknowledge the presence of our Senate President Win, and likewise Senator Imee Marcos. Thank you for attending today's hearing. I would like to ask the Committee Secretary to acknowledge the resource persons present for today.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Good morning. Good morning also to our Senate President and Senator Marcos. For the briefing on the proposed FY 2027 budget of the Office of the Vice President, I would like to acknowledge our resource persons from

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: the OVP. We have Attorney Zuleica Lopez, Assistant Secretary Lemwel Ortono, Attorney Rosely Sanchez, Attorney Sunshine Chari Faarda, Director Norman Baloro, Attorney Emily Rose Torentira, Attorney Kelvin Jerome Pe[unclear], Miss Julieta Villed Rey, Mr. Ard Eje, and Mr. Simon Jezer Lao. We have also invited representatives from the DBM and COA. From DBM, we have Assistant Director Lulu Vispo, Miss Lorian Jaivier, Mr.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: George Catalan, Mr. Edward J. Perales, and Miss Queen Valerie Macaspak. For COA, we have Mr. Fahad bin Abdul Malik Tumawis and Miss Zara Jane Tegalan. Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Thank you, our Committee Secretary. Ladies, gentlemen, honorable colleagues in the Senate, guests and resource persons to the Office of the Vice President, a pleasant morning to everyone as we open today's budget hearing of the proposed 2027 budget of the OVP. We recognize the vital role of the Office of the Vice President as a platform for public

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: service through socioeconomic and support programs. Being the second highest executive office of the Philippine government, it shall maintain outstanding delivery of its local programs, dignified international networks and resilient sustainable solutions to the countrywide challenges. For this budget deliberation, we endeavor to efficiently utilize the fiscal resources to meet short and long-term projections, strengthen national readiness and enhance responsiveness to the needs of the

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Filipino people. Moving forward, this representation acknowledges the tradition of interparliamentary courtesy in respect to the Office of the Vice President, while also assuring the public that the fiscal year 2027 proposed expenditure is taken up with due diligence. Thank you very much. So, before we proceed, I would like to ask our Senate President if he has any remarks.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, binabasa ko itong budget ng OVP and nakita ko na compared to last year, it went down by 11%.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: It went down by approximately from P889 million to P785 million.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And nakita ko rin na ang kanilang main program ay yung social...

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: social economic program na tumutulong sa ating mga constituents.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And I saw various components of that program.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So with that, nakita ko na the Office of the Vice President is spending their budget as efficiently, as wisely as possible.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Of course, bilang Vice President, meron din silang mga...

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: kailangan tulungan.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Bilang kayo, mga politicians, marami talagang lumalapit sa amin.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I'm sure kay Vice President, marami rin lumalapit ang humingi ng tulong.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: At itong social economic program will be a tool for her to help her constituents, or our constituents for that matter,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: para mabigyan naman ng relief yung ating mga constituents.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So I only have one question.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Atty. Zulaika, bilang Chief of Staff, may I know where is the Vice President?

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Traditionally kasi pag ganitong mga budget deliberation, the Head of Office comes here to defend their budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Alam mo naman yan. You've been here for the last four years.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And traditionally, even last year when I was the Chairman of the Finance Committee,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: the Vice President took time to come here to defend her budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So may I know, for the record, kung nasaan ang ating butihing Vice President?

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: Yes. Thank you, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: Good morning, ladies and gentlemen.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: The Vice President is actually representing former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: in the inurnment of our long-serving city planner in Davao City.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: So the schedule for the inurnment  is today, October 20.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: So she's the representative of the former President.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Is that in the country or outside of the country?

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: Just in the country, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Just in the country.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Well, we hope that sa plenary, we would welcome her presence to further defend her budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: This is the first step.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Alam mo naman yan, may second step pa tayo, which is plenary.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And we would hope that she can give time.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: We would hope that she can give time to represent her office and defend her budget in plenary.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: But at this time, during the committee level, I'll leave it to our Chairman,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: who is the one spearheading the budget of the entire bureaucracy.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So I'll leave the shepherding to him on the budget of the OVP.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So with that, Mr. Chairman, maraming salamat.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Thank you, our Senate President.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Likewise, the Chair would like to acknowledge the presence of Senator Bong Go.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At this point, I'd like to open the floor to our colleagues if there are any questions for the OVP.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Yes, Senator Marcos.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Yes, Chairman.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Thank you very much and welcome to the Office of the Vice President, to the halls of the Senate.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: At gusto ko lang sumali dun sa sinabi ng ating mahal na Chairman, si JV, na i-extend na lang yung traditional courtesy natin.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Sa ating mga executive offices, as we do, to the other house, the House of Representatives.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: At kahit wala rito ang Pangulo, kahit wala yung pangalawang Pangulo, e talagang namang hinahayaan.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Higit sa lahat, nabawasan pa yung budget ninyo ng higit sa 11%.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kaya't ang tanging tanong ko na lamang is maliban dun sa sinasabing mga...

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Socio-economic programs, ano ba talaga ang mababawasan?

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kasi alam ko maraming tulong, ako yung nakasama sa mag-negosyo-taday na iba't-ibang mga opening ninyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Ano ang matatamaan at mapeperwisyo ba yung mga beneficiaries natin?

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: At the outset, Your Honor, much of the budget is really because there is a reprogramming or recalibration of our programs.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: One good example could be, as you mentioned, the mag-negosyo-taday.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: This year, we're concentrating on monitoring and evaluation and checking if it actually has made impact, this particular program.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: Therefore, we have identified a reduced number of beneficiaries and target beneficiaries for the year.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: Another example could be, maybe we can have our Director for Operations, Pagbabago.

segments.speaker: OVP Director Norman Baloro
segments.text: Thank you, Yusek. Madam Chair, this is with regard to our Pagbabago a Million Learners campaign.

segments.speaker: OVP Director Norman Baloro
segments.text: We are about to reach already our target, which is 1 million learners to be given with the Pagbabago bags, with raincoats and dental kits as well.

segments.speaker: OVP Director Norman Baloro
segments.text: So parang yun na rin po, parang napakasaya na rin po namin dahil hindi naaabot ng 2028, ma-re-reach na rin po namin yung goal namin for the 1 million learners.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Thank you and congratulations on the early attainment of the goals stated, your targets.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: At syempre, gusto rin namin malaman dun sa mag-negosyo-taday.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: Kung ilan dun talaga tuloy-tuloy na nag-negosyo, kasi maganda yung sinasabing nyo, kulang na kulang ang monitoring at evaluation sa buong pamahalaan.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: At mahusay naman that we take a step back and assess the success and the accomplishment in our actual projects.

segments.speaker: Senator Imee R. Marcos
segments.text: With that, I move that we endorse the budget of the Vice President to the plenary.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Thank you, Senator Marcos. But before that, I would like to ask Senator Bong Go.

segments.text: and if it's

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: successful, sayag naman kung ito'y makakatulong

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: sa mga negosyo?

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: Yes, Your Honor. Recalibration

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: is a program

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: and program mix.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, with that,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: actually, we will support

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: the social programs of the office

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: of the Vice President and

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: in spite of all of

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: the political noise, we are still hoping that

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: one day that we will have

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: unity

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: in this country.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And we are looking

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and praying for that in the future.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And I send our regards to our

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Vice President. We're hoping to

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: see her during plenary.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: And the Committee Chair would like to thank

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: everyone, especially our

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: esteemed resource persons

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: led by the Chief of Staff of the OVP

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Attorney, Zolaica

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Lopez, and the rest of the

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: OVP family. Thank you for

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: joining this morning's

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: budget hearing.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: There being no further questions, the budget of the

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Office of the Vice President is deemed submitted for the

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: plenary's consideration.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Subject to the discussion and submission of

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: documents requested.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Gusto ko sana 15 minutes eh, kaso

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: tumagal lang konti. So,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and send our regards to

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: our Vice President.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Magandang umaga po. This briefing is hereby

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: suspended. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Undersecretary Zuleika T. Lopez
segments.text: Thank you, Your Honors.
